description: Zero-runtime-dependency TypeScript client for FileMaker Server OData v4, usable from FileMaker Web Viewers, browsers, and Node.
rules: Import from 'fm-odata-js'; the package is ESM-only and has zero runtime dependencies.
Use the FMOData client's query builder and EntityRef APIs instead of hand-building OData URLs.
FileMaker Server OData has server-specific quirks (authentication, $count, dates, TLS, containers); consult the FileMaker quirks docs before working around unexpected behavior.
Script execution goes through the script API; handle FMScriptError for script failures.
In FileMaker Web Viewers use the IIFE build (global FMODataLib); in browsers and Node use the ESM build.
